coverage.name: Morgan County
limitations: Checked 2026-10-10: the Elections Department page posts 27 English sample ballot styles (with Spanish versions); all 27 were read. The only county question is Morgan County Question 1A: "Shall the proposed Morgan County Home Rule Charter be adopted?" No TABOR notice or participating-entities list is posted.

Excluded on review on 2026-09-26: Question 1A, referred by Resolution 2026 BCC 38 (September 1, 2026; scanned) and numbered in Resolution 2026 BCC 41. It adopts a form of county government, not a tax or housing measure on its face; the proposed charter contains an Article IX on planning. The charter PDF is scanned and only its cover and table of contents were read.

Not county questions and not housing: Central Colorado Water Conservancy District Ballot Issue 7B and its Groundwater Management Subdistrict Ballot Issue 7C (water), and Buffalo School District RE-4J Ballot Issue 5A (debt).
Commissioners' agendas January to September 29, 2026 show no other county ballot referral.

coverage.name: Hillrose (town)
limitations: Rechecked 2026-10-12: the Morgan County Elections Department page lists the same sample ballot styles per precinct (State and County, Town of Wiggins, Central Water, Central CO Water and Groundwater Management, and RE4J School variants). None is a Town of Hillrose style, and no TABOR notice or participating-entities list is posted.

A Town of Hillrose website (hillrosecolorado.org) was found and read on 2026-10-12. It says "Website under construction, not all links are funtional"; its newest items are a February 21, 2022 board agenda and the 2021 water quality report, and it has no election content. A separate town election cannot be ruled out from the town's own records.
Left at official_notice_unavailable (checked 2026-10-12): no participating-entities list and no town election page or notice to read.
